source_quote: I am still holding my 10% long runner from the 3pm 7434 Failed Breakdown yesterday.
text: Positioning: Mancini is still holding a 10% long runner from Monday's 3pm 7434 Failed Breakdown, stop under the prior day's low.

source_quote: Everything between 7506 and 7418 is chop and 7434 remains a key magnet in this range.
text: Regime: classic Mode 2 (rangebound) price action. ES is rangebound 7418 to 7506. Everything between 7506 and 7418 is chop and 7434 remains a key magnet in this range.

source_quote: Mode 2 ranges constantly shift and currently support is now 7418. 7418 was the low last Thursday and we set big lows there Monday and Tuesday as well. Obvious shelf there and if this fails now we likely free fall.
text: Range support is now 7418 - last Thursday's low plus big lows Monday and Tuesday, an obvious shelf. If 7418 fails we likely free fall.

source_quote: Recall that whenever a shelf fails (7506) in order for bulls to retain full control that shelf must recover for bulls to restore full control, and they have been unable to so far.
text: Range resistance is 7506. It was a major support cluster Tuesday-Thursday last week, collapsed Thursday, then got its backtest Sunday evening and bulls could not sustain a recovery. That shelf must recover for bulls to restore full control - they have been unable so far.

source_quote: 7458 is first support down. I won't engage this but a flush and recovery of this zone is actionable for those who want to trade a riskier region.
text: 7458 is first support down. Mancini will not engage it, but a flush and recovery of this zone is actionable for those who want to trade a riskier region.

source_quote: One option is waiting for 7418 to hold and then recovery 7434. Another option is to wait for a full Failed Breakdown of 7418. Because 7418 has so many touches though, it is becoming liable to fail for good, meaning take profits fast on any Failed Breakdowns here.
text: 7434 is en route but so well tested it is difficult to engage. One option: wait for 7418 to hold and then recover 7434. Another: wait for a full Failed Breakdown of 7418 - but because 7418 has so many touches it is becoming liable to fail for good, so take profits fast on any Failed Breakdown there.

trigger.condition_text: 7418 holds then 7434 recovers, or a full Failed Breakdown of 7418

source_quote: A safer bet is to wait for this to hold then recover the 7418 shelf.
text: 7398 is below there. One could bid it, but Mancini never does when bears control - no knife catching. Safer: wait for 7398 to hold, then recover the 7418 shelf.

source_quote: Instead of just buying this, wait for it to flush and recover via a Failed Breakdown.
text: 7358 is a big support - ES bottomed here June 25th/26th and built the shelf that launched the first three weeks of July's rally. Do not just buy it; wait for it to flush and recover via a Failed Breakdown.

source_quote: Nothing below there until 7311 and this is a very strong support.
text: Nothing below 7358 until 7311, which is a very strong support.

source_quote: Once 7506 clears, ES should dip. Targets are 7533, 7548, 7575, then 7627.
text: Bull case: ES spends more time in the 7418-7506 range engaging the zones above, then breaks out. Once 7506 clears, targets are 7533, 7548, 7575, then 7627. Adding on strength is difficult after Tuesday's hard rally; 7506 recoveries are one entry but very advanced - you want clear acceptance, or the non-acceptance protocol, ideally the former.

source_quote: For the 7418 short, ideally one can put in a final bounce or here, then one can short beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7411 trigger down.
text: Bear case begins below 7418 - a breakdown trade, which is not Mancini's edge (80% of breakdowns trap; expect over 60% to fail even when executed well). For the 7418 short, ideally wait for a final bounce, then short beneath the lows of that bounce. Likely 7411 trigger down.

trigger.condition_text: below 7418, short beneath the lows of a final bounce

source_quote: 7506 is one zone (this is well tested now but may have one dip left in it), 7548 is another, and 7575 is another.
text: Short zones for those who take them (Mancini does not short ES): 7506 - well tested now but may have one dip left in it - plus 7548 and 7575.
FOMC lands at 2pm ET Wednesday - the catalyst that may finally resolve the tight range.

source_quote: My general lean is we can break this out which targets 7533, 7545, 7575, then 7627.
text: Summary lean: the 7418-7506 range can break out, targeting 7533, 7545, 7575, then 7627. Stated as a lean only - trade the plan level to level, no predictions.
